detailed_description: The Privacy Policy Generator creates a general markdown-style privacy policy template from a browser-side form. Enter website name, website URL, company name, and contact email, then choose whether the template should include sections for personal data collection, cookies, analytics, ads, user accounts, and data selling. The Generate button fills a readonly textarea with a template that includes a last-updated date and a reminder to review, customize, and consult a legal professional. The tool does not scan websites, detect cookies, provide legal advice, guarantee GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance, generate jurisdiction-specific policies, export PDF/HTML/YAML, provide an API, or track regulatory changes.
usage_steps: Enter the website name, website URL, company name, and contact email.
Select which common sections apply: personal data, cookies, analytics, ads, user accounts, or data selling.
Click Generate to create the markdown-style privacy policy template.
Review and edit the generated text for your situation.
Copy the output when you are ready to move it into another editor for legal review.
usage_examples: Draft a starting privacy policy for a small website before professional review.
Include a cookies and analytics section for a prototype site that uses basic tracking.
Add an accounts section for a product demo that allows sign-ups.
Copy the generated markdown-style text into a document for manual editing.
